name: 泥潭1
english_description: An independent branch of the NT/nitan ('Mire') engine family — deep testing found no exact code match to sibling games nitan170911, nitan6, or hhsj, confirming it grew up on its own. New characters must first pass through a 'registration room' and use a built-in register-with-email command before their attributes are even assigned, an extra gate reminiscent of the 'reincarnation' step found in the Hell/Doing family of games. Character creation also layers a temperament type and a character-class type on top of the usual gender choice.
